data.narrative:
Exolaunch is a bootstrapped space & aerospace company founded by Dmitriy Sternharz and Dmitriy Bogdanov, both with TU Berlin space technology backgrounds. The valuation universe comprises 13 peers across Space & Aerospace: 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private entities including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard triangulation methods face material constraints here. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while 14 same-sector comparables exist, zero meet narrow stage/tier filters required for statistical reliability. The public-comp anchoring method cannot proceed without disclosed revenue; private space companies rarely file financials, and Exolaunch's revenue is not on file. The public Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 27.4x P/S across the five tickers listed, but lacks the denominator needed to extrapolate a valuation range.

Given the bootstrapped stage, founder pedigree, and the absence of disclosed financials or comparable same-stage transaction data, this analysis cannot support a quantified valuation range. Resolution requires either (1) disclosed revenue or revenue guidance from management, (2) recent transaction multiples from comparable-stage space technology companies, or (3) clarification of current funding status. The sector median P/S of 27.4x represents an upper-bound anchor only, applicable only if revenue becomes available.
